card.text: Young star 146 parsecs away in Ophiuchus, one of a close pair with a giant planet photographed far out.

introduction.text: ROXs 42B A and B are young stars 11 au apart, circling each other every 31 years. Their planet b lies about 150 au out.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: A blackbody at the star's published temperature. No surface picture exists.

brightness-sector-91.title: Brightness map, Sector 91
brightness-sector-91.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Apr to May 2025
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
